name: Sign in and save a quick Indian meal
description: Verifies an authenticated user can add a standard Indian meal and find the saved entry after a reload.
steps: Sign in or create an account using one of the available sign-in methods
On Overview, use Quick add to add Idli + sambar
Confirm the meal appears in Recently logged and the daily totals update
Reload the page and confirm the meal is still present
expected: Idli + sambar appears in the signed-in user's diary after reload and the daily nutrition totals include its estimate.

name: Analyse a meal from a written description
covers: calorie protein carbohydrate and sugar breakdown
description: Verifies a written Indian meal description produces a visible nutrition estimate before it is saved.
steps: Enter '2 medium idlis with 1 bowl of sambar and 1 tablespoon coconut chutney' in the meal description
Review the estimated calories, protein, carbs, sugars, dish breakdown and assumptions
expected: A structured estimate appears with dish names, portions, all four nutrition values, a confidence label and recipe or portion assumptions.

name: Edit and permanently delete a food log
description: Verifies users can amend saved nutrition values and remove a meal with a confirmation step.
setup: Sign in and use Quick add to create a Poha meal
steps: Edit the Poha entry and change its calories to 275
Save changes and confirm the updated value is visible
Choose Delete for the Poha entry and confirm the deletion
expected: The edited value is saved, the confirmation removes the selected meal, and the deleted entry remains absent after reload.

name: Show a helpful error when meal analysis is unavailable
description: Verifies the analyser gives clear feedback when the analysis endpoint returns an error rather than silently losing the request.
steps: Sign in and enter 'one bowl vegetable upma' in the meal description
Select Analyse nutrition while the analysis request is faulted
expected: A visible message explains that the estimate is temporarily unavailable and the user can retry after the service recovers.

name: Analyse a meal photo on a mobile viewport
description: Verifies the mobile photo workflow accepts a food image and returns an estimated nutrition breakdown.
steps: Sign in and open Overview on the mobile viewport
Tap Take a meal photo and choose a clear food image from the device
expected: The selected photo is previewed and the analysis result shows estimated calories, protein, carbs, sugars, dish components and confidence.
